page_title: Burette | Molecular Quick Look and workspace for macOS

summary.name: Burette
summary.one_liner: Burette is a free, open-source macOS app that previews molecular files in 3D via Finder's Quick Look and provides a workspace for comparing, editing and exporting structures.
use_cases: preview protein or molecule files in Finder without opening an app
inspect docking poses and ligand pockets
summary.what_it_does: Burette lets you select a molecular file in Finder and press Space to see an interactive 3D preview through Quick Look, with rotation and zoom. The Finder integration also provides thumbnails for over 100 file types. The separate molecular workspace compares structures side by side, browses compound collections, maps chemical space, and exports figures. It also shows docking poses and ligand pockets. The page lists supported formats including PDB, CIF, SDF, MOL2, XYZ, SMILES, CSV, CUBE, LOG, OUT, PSI4 and VASP. Molecular views use Mol*, and an optional xyzrender engine renders vector artwork.
notable: Finder Quick Look preview of molecular files in interactive 3D
Codex agent plugin to open structures and focus ligands
Installable via Homebrew cask or direct download
caveats: Public downloads are ad-hoc signed, so macOS may require first-launch approval in System Settings
Only macOS is named on the page
